title: Root-cause matrix and failure drilldown dashboard for inference errors
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a unified failure drilldown dashboard and root-cause matrix that correlates tracing spans, ingress metrics, and log-derived error taxonomies for inference requests. The dashboard should classify failures into timeouts, overload (queue/backpressure), model execution errors (OOM, corrupted weights), and transport errors (HTTP/gRPC codes). It must enable engineers and SREs to pivot from a high-level SLO/regression view into traces, logs, and sampling-level artifacts for RCA.
comments: 2025-02-15: Kickoff with Observability and Runtime teams. Agreed to reuse new trace-context header and add span attributes for model_variant and batch_id.
2025-02-18: Decided on taxonomy buckets: TIMEOUT, OVERLOAD, MODEL_ERROR, TRANSPORT_ERROR, CONFIG_ERROR. Will emit error_code and failure_reason tags from runtime.
2025-02-24: PoC pipeline in staging created: logproc job enriches nginx/gRPC logs with trace_id; metrics team produced per-route error counters with reason label.
2025-02-27: UX review with PM/Design. Feedback: need latency percentiles per failure type and a compact root-cause matrix heatmap by service layer.
2025-03-01: Engineering review: will implement adaptive sampling for traces on overload spikes to preserve budget; PR created for trace hooks (github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1127).
2025-03-03: Blocking: need finalized naming for failure_reason tag across runtime and edge proxies. Action: sync with Edge infra on 2025-03-04.
steps: Instrument runtime to emit failure_reason and failure_class attributes on the main request span
Augment log pipeline to join proxy logs with traces and tag transport-level codes
Create metric counters (per-route, per-model, per-failure_class) with consistent label set
Build Grafana dashboard: overview SLO impact, root-cause matrix heatmap, failure-type breakdown, trace-sample list
Add adaptive trace sampling rules: preserve traces for new or high-severity failure types
Wire up alerts and automated runbook links for top 5 failure signatures
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows failure distribution by TIMEOUT/OVERLOAD/MODEL_ERROR/TRANSPORT_ERROR/CONFIG_ERROR for last 7 and 30 days
Each failure row links to representative trace samples and the originating log lines in LogQL/ES
SLO page automatically computes error budget burn attributable to each failure_class
Failure taxonomy labels are emitted by runtime and proxies with stable names (failure_reason, failure_class)
Adaptive trace sampling prevents >50% budget increase in production while retaining high-fidelity samples for anomalies
Runbook links appear in the dashboard for the top 3 actionable failure signatures
